'''Gree sailships''' were rare [[Solar sailer/Legends|sailships]] used by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The sailships were part of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of derelict ships that formed a ring around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mugg Fallow]], the presumed [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mnggal-Mnggal]]. The Mnggal-Mnggal used its mind-controlled [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] to pilot the ships there as macabre decoration.<ref name="TUR" />
